زِبْلٌ (S, Mgh, Msb, K) and ↓ زَبِيلٌ (K) i. q. سِرْجِينٌ (S) or سِرْقِينٌ (Mgh, K, TA) [Dung of horses or other solid-hoofed animals, or fresh dung of camels, sheep and goats, wild oxen, and the like; used for manure]; and the like thereof. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And the former, i. q. حَقِيبَةٌ [i. e. A bag, or receptacle, in which a man puts his travellingprovisions; and any other thing that is conveyed behind him on his beast: &c.]. (AA, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
